conf.name: api
conf.description: Dependencies needed by clients of this module at compile time (and at runtime) that clients are unlikely to be aware of because they would not normally need to explicitly import any objects from these dependencies. Modules with no downstream dependencies should never define a dependency using this configuration.

conf.name: compile
conf.description: Configuration needed to compile this module.

conf.name: compileOnly
conf.description: Configuration for identifying dependencies that are needed to compile but that are NOT needed at runtime, either because they affect source compilation only (e.g., source-time annotations) or because they are provided by the deplyoment platform (e.g., a Java EE Application server). These dependencies are NOT subject to transitive dependency resolution.

conf.name: embedded
conf.description: Dependencies needed by the client at compile time (and at runtime) that will be directly incorporated into the final artifact. These dependencies are NOT subject to transitive dependency resolution.

conf.name: runtime
conf.description: Dependencies needed by clients of this module at runtime that are not needed to compile the artifact.

conf.name: test
conf.description: Configuration needed to test this module.

conf.name: master
conf.description: Configuration provided for referring to this module's artifact by itself without any of its dependencies. This configuration is useful when building assemblies such as .war and .ear files.

conf.name: ear
conf.description: Configuration for identifying dependencies that need to be packaged in a JEE EAR file

conf.name: war
conf.description: Configuration for identifying dependencies that need to be packaged in a JEE WAR file in the WEB-INF/lib folder

conf.name: sar
conf.description: Configuration for identifying dependencies that need to be packaged in a JBoss SAR file

dependencies.defaultconfmapping: api->api(default); compile->api(default); compileOnly->master(default); embedded->master(default); runtime->runtime(default); test->runtime(default); ear->master(default); war->master(default)
